highlights: four bedroom link detached family home
summary: A rare opportunity to acquire this outstanding granary conversion, beautifully positioned within the heart of the picturesque village of Winston - one of Teesdale’s hidden gems.
description:
This property is for sale by the Modern Method of Auction, meaning the buyer and seller are to Complete within 56 days (the "Reservation Period"). Interested parties personal data will be shared with the Auctioneer (iamsold). If considering buying with a mortgage, inspect and consider the property carefully with your lender before bidding. A Buyer Information Pack is provided. The winning bidder will pay £349.00 including VAT for this pack which you must view before bidding. The buyer signs a Reservation Agreement and makes payment of a non-refundable Reservation Fee of 4.5% of the purchase price including VAT, subject to a minimum of £6,600.00 including VAT. This is paid to reserve the property to the buyer during the Reservation Period and is paid in addition to the purchase price. This is considered within calculations for Stamp Duty Land Tax. Services may be recommended by the Agent or Auctioneer in which they will receive payment from the service provider if the service is taken. Payment varies but will be no more than £450.00. These services are optional.

Tucked away beside St Andrew's Church at the end of a peaceful mews, this exceptional stone-built home enjoys a truly idyllic setting surrounded by rolling countryside and far-reaching rural views. Steeped in character and charm, the property offers spacious and versatile accommodation perfectly suited to modern family living, combined with the tranquillity of village life. Winston is renowned for its scenic beauty, with idyllic riverside walks along the River Tees and direct access to the renowned Teesdale Way from the doorstep. Despite its rural setting, the property remains conveniently placed within easy reach of the historic market town of Barnard Castle, offering a range of independent shops, cafés, restaurants and everyday amenities. Darlington is also readily accessible, providing excellent transport links and further facilities. Originally converted from a traditional granary, the home retains a wealth of character features throughout. The welcoming entrance hallway leads into a bright and spacious open-plan lounge, flooded with natural light and ideal for both relaxing and entertaining. A second reception room, currently used as a dining room, benefits from French doors opening directly onto the rear garden, creating a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living during the warmer months. The well-proportioned kitchen provides ample storage and preparation space, along with internal access to the integral double garage for added convenience. A ground floor WC completes the accommodation. To the first floor, there are four generously sized bedrooms, each enjoying pleasant outlooks and offering flexibility for family living, guests, or home working. The principal bedroom benefits from an en-suite, while the family bathroom is well-appointed with both bath and separate shower. Externally, the property is equally impressive, with beautifully established gardens to both front and rear. Mature planting, lawned areas and well-stocked borders provide colour, privacy, and a perfect setting for outdoor dining and entertaining. A substantial driveway offers parking for multiple vehicles and leads to the integral double garage. Double gated access opens to a useful walk-through woodstore area. Offered to the market with no onward chain, early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the setting, space, and unique qualities of this exceptional home.

ENTRANCE HALL Accessed via a composite entrance door, the welcoming entrance hallway immediately sets the tone for the character and warmth found throughout the home. The space features an attractive exposed ceiling beam, adding to the property's charm and heritage, together with inset ceiling spotlight and a radiator, creating a bright and inviting first impression while providing access to the principal ground floor accommodation.

OPEN PLAN LOUNGE / DINING ROOM A truly fabulous and character-filled space, the open-plan lounge and dining room forms the heart of this beautiful home, combining warmth, charm, and an impressive sense of scale. The lounge area is particularly striking, flooded with natural light and showcasing a wealth of original features, including exposed stonework walls and a stunning inglenook fireplace housing a log burner, complete with a feature sleeper over, creating a dramatic and inviting focal point. Two large arched windows to the front aspect frame picturesque views and further enhance the sense of light and openness, complemented by an additional UPVC-framed double-glazed window to the rear. Feature beamed ceilings run throughout the space, reinforcing the characterful nature of the property, while two radiators ensure year-round comfort. The dining area flows seamlessly from the lounge, maintaining the same sense of space and character. It benefits from a UPVC-framed double-glazed window, radiator, and an additional feature ceiling beam, along with stairs providing access to the first floor. This superbly balanced living area offers an ideal setting for both relaxed everyday living and stylish entertaining.

RECEPTION ROOM TWO Currently utilised as a formal dining space, this versatile second reception room offers excellent flexibility to suit a range of lifestyle needs. Generously proportioned and filled with natural light, the room features a UPVC-framed double-glazed window along with UPVC-framed double-glazed French doors that open directly onto the garden, creating a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living. This bright and adaptable space could equally serve as a second sitting room, home office, or garden room, depending on individual requirements.

KITCHEN/BREAKFAST ROOM A beautifully appointed and characterful kitchen fitted with a charming range of solid oak base and wall cabinets, thoughtfully crafted to include a feature dresser unit, adding both warmth and traditional appeal to the space. Complementing the cabinetry are laminate work surfaces, with an inset sink unit complete with drainer and mixer tap, and tasteful tiling to splashback and work areas. The kitchen is well-equipped for modern living, offering integrated fridge and freezer, plumbing for an automatic washing machine and dishwasher, and a double range cooker providing an excellent focal point for cooking enthusiasts. Feature ceiling beams enhance the character of the room, while inset ceiling spotlights provide a bright and practical working environment. Two UPVC-framed double-glazed windows allow for plenty of natural light, further enhancing the welcoming feel. The room also benefits from an integral door providing direct access to the double garage, as well as loft access, adding further convenience and practicality.

FIRST FLOOR LANDING A bright and characterful landing space, enhanced by three UPVC-framed double-glazed windows which allow natural light to flood through, creating an airy and welcoming feel. The area features attractive exposed ceiling beams, adding to the property's charm and continuity of character throughout. Further benefits include a radiator providing warmth, loft access, and a useful built-in over-stairs storage cupboard, offering practical storage solutions. The landing also provides access to all first-floor bedrooms and the family bathroom, serving as a central and well-connected part of the home.

BEDROOM ONE A spacious and beautifully appointed principal bedroom, offering a superb range of fitted wardrobes and drawer units, thoughtfully designed to provide excellent storage whilst still allowing ample space for additional freestanding furniture. The room enjoys a pleasant dual aspect, with UPVC-framed double-glazed windows to both aspects, allowing natural light to fill the space and enhancing the sense of openness and comfort. A radiator provides warmth, while a private door leads through to the en suite facilities, adding a touch of convenience and luxury to this impressive principal suite.

EN SUITE A well-appointed en suite, fitted with a modern white suite comprising a shower cubicle with inset mains-fed shower, wash hand basin, and WC. The room is finished with stylish tiled walls and flooring, complemented by the luxury of underfloor heating for added comfort. Inset ceiling spotlights provide a bright and contemporary feel, creating a sleek and functional space that perfectly serves the principal bedroom.

BEDROOM TWO Another generously proportioned double bedroom, offering a comfortable and versatile living space. The room benefits from a UPVC-framed double-glazed window providing pleasant natural light, along with a radiator ensuring year-round comfort. The bedroom also features a range of fitted wardrobes and drawer units, providing excellent storage solutions, while still allowing ample space for additional freestanding furniture, making it a highly practical and well-balanced room.

BEDROOM THREE A well-presented and versatile bedroom featuring a UPVC-framed double-glazed window providing natural light, along with a radiator for comfort. The room benefits from fitted bedroom furniture offering excellent storage, and an attractive feature ceiling beam which adds to the character of the space. Ideal as a guest room, study, or additional bedroom as required.

BEDROOM FOUR A well-proportioned bedroom featuring a UPVC-framed double-glazed window, allowing for natural light to fill the space. The room benefits from an attractive feature ceiling beam, adding character and charm, along with a radiator providing comfort throughout the year. This versatile room offers an ideal space for a bedroom, guest room, or home office if required.

FAMILY BATHROOM A beautifully appointed family bathroom, fitted with a modern white suite comprising a panelled jacuzzi bath, wash hand basin set into a stylish tiled vanity unit, shower cubicle with inset mains-fed shower, and WC. The room is finished with fully tiled walls and flooring, enhanced by the comfort of underfloor heating. Inset ceiling spotlights create a bright and contemporary feel, while additional features include a radiator and heated towel rail, providing both practicality and comfort. This impressive bathroom offers a luxurious and well-designed space for family use.

EXTERNALLY To the frontage, the property is approached via a beautifully maintained garden, predominantly laid to lawn, with a neatly presented walkway leading to the front entrance. The approach is enhanced by well-stocked flowerbeds, bursting with a variety of mature flora and shrubbery, alongside attractive gravelled areas which add texture and interest to the setting. There is direct access to the double garage, fitted with electric up-and-over doors, providing both convenience and secure parking/storage. A set of double wrought iron gates leads to a useful wood store area, which in turn provides access through to the rear garden. To the rear, the property truly excels, offering a generously proportioned and wonderfully private outdoor space. A large patio area provides an ideal setting for outdoor seating and entertaining, perfect for enjoying the peaceful surroundings. Steps lead down to a further lawned garden area, beautifully maintained and bordered by an abundance of established trees, flora, and shrubbery, creating a natural haven that attracts a variety of wildlife. A charming summerhouse is tucked away in the corner of the garden, offering a tranquil retreat with delightful open views over adjacent playing fields, further enhancing the sense of space, privacy, and countryside living.
